shorter_prefix_timing.method: Matched native no-observer first public step at CPU 30 on the same six-body loaded scene, one discarded warm repetition, 16 fresh-world repetitions in alternating order. Each result independently checked all body pose and twist components against its observed run.

timing_protocol: 1 warmup plus 5 fresh loaded worlds per block, 3 rotated blocks, nearest-rank p95, same CPU 18 on a shared host. Time surrounds only the first 1 ms simulation step. All six committed body states and the selected call count checked outside the timer.
